v_s.name: Verb stem without its subject ending

transforms.name: ܘ- (and)
transforms.description: The conjunction ܘ- (w-, and), written together with the next word.

transforms.name: ܕ- (of, that)
transforms.description: The proclitic ܕ- (d-): of (the genitive), that, which (relative and subordinating), written together with the next word.

transforms.name: ܒ- (in, with)
transforms.description: The preposition ܒ- (b-, in, with, by), written together with the next word; before an infinitive it makes the gerund of the progressive (ܝܠܹܗ ܒܡܲܪܝܘܿܡܹܐ, he is raising).

transforms.name: ܠ- (to, for)
transforms.description: The preposition ܠ- (l-, to, for; also the marker of a definite object), written together with the next word.

transforms.name: ܟ- (indicative)
transforms.description: The indicative particle ܟܹܐ (kē) written together with a verb that starts with ܐ (ܟܐܵܙܹܠ, he goes).

transforms.name: ܒܕ- (future)
transforms.description: The future particle ܒܸܬ (bit), shortened to ܒܕ- and written together with the verb (ܒܕܐܵܙܹܠ, he will go).

transforms.name: -ܠܝ (I, me)
transforms.description: The L-suffix of the first person singular: the agent of a past verb (I), or the object (me), written after the verb.

transforms.name: -ܠܘܟ (you, m.)
transforms.description: The L-suffix of the second person masculine singular: the agent of a past verb (you), or the object (you), written after the verb.

transforms.name: -ܠܟܝ (you, f.)
transforms.description: The L-suffix of the second person feminine singular: the agent of a past verb (you), or the object (you), written after the verb.

transforms.name: -ܠܗ (he, she; him, her)
transforms.description: The L-suffix of the third person singular, masculine ܠܹܗ or feminine ܠܵܗ̇ (the same letters): the agent of a past verb (he, she), or the object (him, her, it), written after the verb.

transforms.name: -ܠܢ (we, us)
transforms.description: The L-suffix of the first person plural: the agent of a past verb (we), or the object (us), written after the verb.

transforms.name: -ܠܘܟܘܢ (you, pl.)
transforms.description: The L-suffix of the second person plural: the agent of a past verb (you), or the object (you), written after the verb.

transforms.name: -ܠܗܘܢ (they, them)
transforms.description: The L-suffix of the third person plural: the agent of a past verb (they), or the object (them), written after the verb.

transforms.name: past (I)
transforms.description: The past of a Stem I or hollow verb: the past base, with ܝ before the last radical, and the L-suffix of the first person singular (ܦܬ݂ܝܼܚ ܠܹܗ, he opened; ܨܝܼܡ ܠܹܗ, he fasted).

transforms.name: past (you, m.)
transforms.description: The past of a Stem I or hollow verb: the past base, with ܝ before the last radical, and the L-suffix of the second person masculine singular (ܦܬ݂ܝܼܚ ܠܹܗ, he opened; ܨܝܼܡ ܠܹܗ, he fasted).

transforms.name: past (you, f.)
transforms.description: The past of a Stem I or hollow verb: the past base, with ܝ before the last radical, and the L-suffix of the second person feminine singular (ܦܬ݂ܝܼܚ ܠܹܗ, he opened; ܨܝܼܡ ܠܹܗ, he fasted).

transforms.name: past (he, she)
transforms.description: The past of a Stem I or hollow verb: the past base, with ܝ before the last radical, and the L-suffix of the third person singular, masculine ܠܹܗ or feminine ܠܵܗ̇ (the same letters) (ܦܬ݂ܝܼܚ ܠܹܗ, he opened; ܨܝܼܡ ܠܹܗ, he fasted).

transforms.name: past (we)
transforms.description: The past of a Stem I or hollow verb: the past base, with ܝ before the last radical, and the L-suffix of the first person plural (ܦܬ݂ܝܼܚ ܠܹܗ, he opened; ܨܝܼܡ ܠܹܗ, he fasted).

transforms.name: past (you, pl.)
transforms.description: The past of a Stem I or hollow verb: the past base, with ܝ before the last radical, and the L-suffix of the second person plural (ܦܬ݂ܝܼܚ ܠܹܗ, he opened; ܨܝܼܡ ܠܹܗ, he fasted).

transforms.name: past (they)
transforms.description: The past of a Stem I or hollow verb: the past base, with ܝ before the last radical, and the L-suffix of the third person plural (ܦܬ݂ܝܼܚ ܠܹܗ, he opened; ܨܝܼܡ ܠܹܗ, he fasted).

transforms.name: L-suffix (joined)
transforms.description: An L-suffix written together with the verb (ܦܬ݂ܝܼܚܠܹܗ, he opened; ܦܪܸܫܠܹܐ and ܚܙܹܠܹܐ in the Urmia Bible), as older and informal writing does.

transforms.name: past base
transforms.description: The past base of a Stem I verb, with ܝ before the last radical (ܦܬ݂ܝܼܚ ܠܹܗ, he opened; ܦܬ݂ܝܼܚ, it was opened).

transforms.name: hollow verb
transforms.description: A verb whose middle radical is ܐ writes ܝ for it before an ending and in the past (ܨܵܝܡܵܐ she fasts, ܨܝܼܡ ܠܹܗ he fasted, from ܨܵܐܹܡ).

transforms.name: past base (Stems II/III)
transforms.description: The past base of a Stem II, Stem III or quadriliteral verb, with ܘ after ܡ or after the first radical (ܡܦܘܼܚܸܠ ܠܹܗ, ܡܘܼܪܝܸܡ ܠܹܗ, ܡܬܘܼܪܓܸܡ ܠܹܗ).

transforms.name: past (Stem II, Urmia)
transforms.description: The past of a Stem II verb written without ܡ and with the L-suffix joined, as the Urmia Bible of 1893 writes it (ܬܘܼܪܸܨܠܹܐ, he made, from ܡܬܲܪܸܨ).

transforms.name: past base (ܡܬ- verbs)
transforms.description: The passive past base of a reflexive-passive verb in ܡܬ-, with ܘ before the last radical (ܡܸܬ݂ܟܬ݂ܘܼܒ݂ܸܢ, I was written, from ܡܸܬ݂ܟܬ݂ܹܒ݂).

transforms.name: -ā (she; infinitive)
transforms.description: Third person feminine singular of the non-past or the passive past (ܦܵܬ݂ܚܵܐ, she opens), and the infinitive of a Stem I verb (ܦܬ݂ܵܚܵܐ, to open), which has the same letters.

transforms.name: -ī (they)
transforms.description: Third person plural of the non-past or the passive past (ܦܵܬ݂ܚܝܼ, they open).

transforms.name: -et (you, m.)
transforms.description: Second person masculine singular of the non-past or the passive past (ܦܵܬ݂ܚܹܬ, you open).

transforms.name: -at (you, f.)
transforms.description: Second person feminine singular of the non-past or the passive past (ܦܵܬ݂ܚܵܬܝ, you open).

transforms.name: -ītōn (you, pl.)
transforms.description: Second person plural of the non-past or the passive past (ܦܵܬ݂ܚܝܼܬܘܿܢ, you open).

transforms.name: -ēn, -ān (I)
transforms.description: First person singular of the non-past or the passive past, masculine -ēn or feminine -ān (ܦܵܬ݂ܚܹܢ, I open).

transforms.name: -aḥ (we)
transforms.description: First person plural of the non-past or the passive past (ܦܵܬ݂ܚܲܚ, we open).

transforms.name: past (assimilated L-suffix)
transforms.description: The past of a Stem I verb whose last radical is ܪ or ܠ, with the ܠ of the L-suffix assimilated: ܐ݇ܡܝܼܪܹܗ, he said (for ܐ݇ܡܝܼܪ ܠܹܗ), and in the Urmia Bible ܐ݇ܡܸܪܹܐ, he said; ܫܩܸܠܘܿܢ, they took.

transforms.name: passive participle
transforms.description: The passive participle of a Stem I verb, masculine or plural in -ā (ܦܬ݂ܝܼܚܵܐ, ܦܬ݂ܝܼܚܹ̈ܐ, opened); the feminine in -tā (ܦܬ݂ܝܼܚܬܵܐ) is read through the feminine rule first. With ܝܠܹܗ it makes the perfect.

transforms.name: passive participle (Stems II/III)
transforms.description: The passive participle of a Stem II, Stem III or quadriliteral verb: the past base with -ā (ܡܦܘܼܚܠܵܐ, ܡܘܼܪܝܡܵܐ); the feminine in -tā through the feminine rule.

transforms.name: imperative
transforms.description: Imperative of a Stem I verb, with ܘ before the last radical (ܦܬ݂ܘܿܚ, open!; feminine ܦܬ݂ܘܿܚܝ, plural ܦܬ݂ܘܿܚܘܼܢ); of a hollow verb, with ܘ for its ܐ (ܨܘܼܡ); of a verb in -ē, -ī and plural -aw (ܕܪܝܼ, ܕܪܲܘ).

transforms.name: imperative (Stem III)
transforms.description: Imperative of a Stem III or reflexive ܡܬ- verb, with ܐ for the ܡ (ܐܲܪܝܸܡ, raise!; ܐܸܬ݂ܟܬ݂ܸܒ݂); feminine -ī, plural -ūn (ܐܲܪܝܸܡܝ, ܐܲܪܝܡܘܼܢ; ܐܲܣܬܝܼ, ܐܲܣܬܲܘ from ܡܲܣܬܹܐ).

transforms.name: verbal noun (Stems II/III)
transforms.description: The verbal noun of a Stem II, Stem III or quadriliteral verb: in -ānūṯā (ܡܲܪܝܡܵܢܘܼܬ݂ܵܐ, raising, from ܡܲܪܝܸܡ; ܡܲܣܬܝܵܢܘܼܬ݂ܵܐ, from ܡܲܣܬܹܐ), or without ܡ and with ܘ after the first radical (ܦܘܼܚܵܠܵܐ, from ܡܦܲܚܸܠ).

transforms.name: infinitive (Stems II/III)
transforms.description: The infinitive of a Stem II, Stem III or quadriliteral verb, with ܘ before the last radical (ܡܲܪܝܘܿܡܹܐ, ܡܬܲܪܓܘܿܡܹܐ; ܡܲܣܬܘܿܝܹܐ from ܡܲܣܬܹܐ).

transforms.name: gerund (ܒ- + infinitive)
transforms.description: The gerund, ܒ- with the infinitive (ܒܸܦܬ݂ܵܚܵܐ; ܒܸܕܪܵܝܵܐ from ܕܪܐ), which makes the progressive with the copula (ܝܠܹܗ ܒܸܦܬ݂ܵܚܵܐ, he is opening).

transforms.name: ܗ݇ܘܵܐ (past)
transforms.description: The past particle ܗ݇ܘܵܐ (wā) after a verb, a participle or the copula, written as a separate word or joined to it (ܟܹܐ ܦܵܬ݂ܚܵܐ ܗ݇ܘܵܐ, she used to open).

transforms.name: my
transforms.description: First person singular possessive suffix (ܟܲܠܒܝܼ, my dog); with the same letters the construct plural (ܟܲܠܒ݂ܲܝ̈, the dogs of).

transforms.name: your (m.)
transforms.description: Second person masculine singular possessive suffix (ܟܲܠܒܘܼܟ݂, your dog).

transforms.name: your (f.)
transforms.description: Second person feminine singular possessive suffix (ܟܲܠܒܵܟ݂ܝ, your dog).

transforms.name: his, her
transforms.description: Third person singular possessive suffix, masculine ܹܗ or feminine ܵܗ̇ (ܟܲܠܒܹܗ his dog, ܟܲܠܒܵܗ̇ her dog; on a plural ܟܲܠܒ݂ܘܼ̈ܗܝ, ܟܲܠܒ݂ܘܼ̈ܗ̇).

transforms.name: our
transforms.description: First person plural possessive suffix (ܟܲܠܒܲܢ, our dog).

transforms.name: your (pl.)
transforms.description: Second person plural possessive suffix (ܟܲܠܒܲܘܟ݂ܘܿܢ, your dog).

transforms.name: their
transforms.description: Third person plural possessive suffix (ܟܲܠܒܗܘܿܢ, their dog; on a plural ܟܲܠܒ݂ܲܝ̈ܗܘܿܢ).

transforms.name: plural -ānē
transforms.description: Plural in -ānē (ܛܘܼܪܵܢܹ̈ܐ, mountains, from ܛܘܼܪܵܐ).

transforms.name: plural -wāṯā
transforms.description: Plural in -wāṯā or -awāṯā (ܢܲܗܪܲܘܵܬ݂ܵܐ, rivers, from ܢܲܗܪܵܐ).

transforms.name: feminine / plural -ṯā
transforms.description: Feminine of an adjective or noun in -tā (ܛܵܒ݂ܬܵܐ from ܛܵܒ݂ܵܐ, good; ܐܵܬ݂ܘܿܪܵܝܬܵܐ from ܐܵܬ݂ܘܿܪܵܝܵܐ, Assyrian), or in -ānīṯā of one in -ānā (ܡܲܪܝܡܵܢܝܼܬ݂ܵܐ from ܡܲܪܝܡܵܢܵܐ), and the plural in -āṯā of some nouns (ܫܪ̈ܵܓ݂ܵܬ݂ܵܐ, lamps).

transforms.name: plural -yāṯā
transforms.description: Plural in -yāṯā of a feminine noun in -tā (ܝܕ݂ܵܥ̈ܝܵܬ݂ܵܐ, from ܝܕ݂ܵܥܬܵܐ; ܚܲܕ݂̈ܘܼܝܵܬ݂ܵܐ, joys, from ܚܲܕ݂ܘܼܬ݂ܵܐ).

transforms.name: absolute plural -īn
transforms.description: Absolute plural in -īn (ܟܲܠܒ݂ܝܼ̈ܢ, from ܟܲܠܒܵܐ), used after numbers and in set phrases.

transforms.name: construct state
transforms.description: The construct (or absolute) state of a noun, without the -ā of the emphatic state (ܒܹܝܬ݂ ܣܸܦܪܵܐ, school, from ܒܲܝܬܵܐ; ܡܲܠܟܲܬ݂, from ܡܲܠܟܬ݂ܵܐ).

transforms.name: possessive (consonant-final noun)
transforms.description: A possessive suffix on a noun that ends in a consonant, mostly a loanword (ܐܲܘܛܘܿܒܘܼܣܹܗ, his bus, from ܐܲܘܛܘܿܒܘܼܣ).

transforms.name: plural (consonant-final noun)
transforms.description: The plural in -āṯā of a noun that ends in a consonant (ܐܲܘܛܘܿܒܘܼ̈ܣܵܬ݂ܵܐ, buses, from ܐܲܘܛܘܿܒܘܼܣ).

transforms.name: irregular plural
transforms.description: A noun with a plural or possessive stem of its own (ܒܵܬܹ̈ܐ, houses; ܒ̈ܢܵܬ݂ܵܐ, daughters; ܢܸܫܹ̈ܐ, women; ܐܸܒ̈ܢܹܐ, sons; ܐܲܒ݂ܘܼܢ, our father).

transforms.name: spelling variant
transforms.description: A spelling of a numeral or particle that the dictionary refers to a pointed form it has no row for, or does not list: ܬܪܵܝ (two) for ܬܪܹܝܢ, ܡܵܐܐ (hundred) for ܐܸܡܐܵܐ, ܐܘܦ (also) for ܐܵܦ, ܐܸܕܝܘܼ ܝܘܿܡܵܐ (this day) for ܐܸܕܝܘܿܡ (today).

transforms.name: with a pronoun
transforms.description: A preposition with a pronoun suffix (ܥܲܡܹܗ, with him; ܥܠܘܼܗܝ, on him; ܩܵܬܝ, for me; ܒܹܗ, in it; ܠܹܗ, to him).

transforms.name: irregular verb
transforms.description: A form of an irregular verb, written out: ܝܵܗ݇ܒ݂ܹܠ, to give (ܝܵܗ݇ܒ݂ܵܐ, ܝܘܼܗ݇ܒ݂ܹܠ ܠܹܗ, ܗܲܒ݂݇ܠ); the imperatives of ܐܵܙܹܠ, to go (ܙܹܠ݇), ܐܵܬ݂ܹܐ, to come (ܬܵܐ), and ܗܵܘܹܐ, to be (ܗ݇ܘܝܼ).

transforms.name: imperative (Stem II)
transforms.description: Imperative of a Stem II or quadriliteral verb, without the ܡ (ܦܲܚܸܠ, from ܡܦܲܚܸܠ; ܬܲܪܓܸܡ, from ܡܬܲܪܓܸܡ); feminine -ī, plural -ūn; of a verb in -ē, -ī and plural -aw (ܢܲܬܝܼ, ܢܲܬܲܘ).

transforms.name: copula
transforms.description: A present form of the copula (ܝܼܘܸܢ I am, ܝܼܘܸܬ you are, ܝܼܠܹܗ he is, ܝܼܘܲܚ we are, ܝܼܬܘܿܢ you are, ܝܼܢܵܐ they are), under ܝܼܠܹܗ and the verb ܗܵܘܹܐ.

transforms.name: ܟܹܐ (indicative)
transforms.description: The indicative particle ܟܹܐ (kē) spelled ܟܝ.
